subject: Seating Arrangements
question: Five friends P, Q, R, S and T sit in a row facing north. R is at the extreme left. T is at the extreme right. Q is immediately to the right of R. S is not adjacent to T. Who sits in the middle?
explanation: Position 1 = R, 2 = Q, 5 = T. S is not adjacent to T, so S is at position 3 and P at position 4.
